title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:it-my-own-line
canDo: I can write one line about myself from a closed supply of known words, with nothing to copy, and put the accent on every è that means is.

payoff.summary: Complete IT-W260-my-own-line: a name and one more fact, chosen rather than copied, with every e checked for is or and before anything else.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. The Italian-specific check arrives with it: the accent on è is part of the letter, and a hand that drops it writes and where it meant is.
